logline: The alley cats and the bunny gang meet in a warehouse for a rumble, and every time someone tells the dog in the red jacket to beat it, they throw something out of the door and he brings it back, until both gangs drop flat on the floor; he drops the ball on the cats' leader, and her lazy flick sends him pouncing for more.
new: the TikTok cut keeps the main's shots on their own bars (the official sound is the main cut itself, 0.5 s earlier and 20 s shorter, at 0.08% faster) and squeezes the collapse and the lazy-flick button onto chorus 2's first four lines, which sing the same words as the main's last four; 138 beats, so the loop keeps the beat
